title: ARC instruments: reference code and design-sensitivity tools for the theory-level predictions of the ARC Theory and Recursive Dynamics
description: Executable decision rules for the twenty-two registered propositions of the ARC Theory's theory-level preregistration, with the reviews' counterexample intervals pinned as tests; design-sensitivity simulators for the deciding experiments (form discrimination, ceiling-chain precision, coupling identification, burden identification, corrector dependence, blinding integrity, the P5 and P16 designs); sealed-prediction and held-out partition tooling; and parity checks for the copies held in the deciding units. Reference code and a design instrument, not a validated deciding instrument and not empirical evidence. The registration governs; where the frozen text and this code differ, the text decides and the code is corrected.
